URL: https://www.iea.org/reports/oil-market-report-october-2026
(Search snippet content — full report page 403'd on direct fetch; IEA's own reporting language)

Renewed attacks in the Gulf have left the recovery fragile. Robust Gulf of Oman ship-to-ship transfers helped lift total oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz by 3.7 mb/d to 10.9 mb/d, while the swift return of East-West pipeline flows increased overall bypass exports by 970 kb/d to 5.6 mb/d. However, due to heightened security concerns amid increased Houthi attacks in the region in October, projections for the remainder of the year were left largely unchanged.

(Related, CNN 20 Oct, https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/20/business/oil-prices-next-year-intl — headline only, fetch returned 451: "Oil parked above $110 a barrel as IEA warns energy markets won't return to normal next year")
